question:
Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: male patients refers to Sex = 'M'; normal level of white blood cells refers to WBC > 3.5 and WBC <9.0; abnormal fibrinogen level refers to FG < = 150 or FG > = 450; Don't compute repetitive ones.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND L.XCL_030 > 3.5
  AND L.XCL_030 < 9.0
  AND (L.XCL_037 <= 150 OR L.XCL_037 >= 450)
